question: In MS-Word 2016, the 'Aa' feature within the Font group of the Home tab represents the ________ option.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Change Case**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In MS-Word 2016, the 'Aa' feature** within the Font group of the Home tab represents the Change Case option. 
 
• The case menu offers four options;
 
 
• **Sentence case:** It capitalizes the first letter of each sentence.
 
• **Lowercase:** It changes the text from uppercase to lowercase.
 
• **Uppercase:** It capitalizes all the letters of your text.
 
• **Capitalize Each Word: **It capitalizes the first letter of each word.
 
 
 
• **Toggle Case:** This feature enables you to switch between two different case views, such as Capitalize Each Word and Capitalize Each Word.
